answers.valueEn: The car is original paint except for both bumpers, the hood, and the rear right door. Signs of disassembly on the rear right door and front left fender. Broken base on the front left headlight. Minor chip in the front windshield. Weak hood struts. Peeling on the front left inner wheel house sheet metal behind the shock absorber. Torn front and rear Hardy discs (flex discs). Oil vapor from the oil cap and oil pan. Wear on the rear right door handle. Missing headlight access cover in the front left wheel well liner.
